atlas.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: transparent anatomy game atlas, nine illustrations, exact 3 columns by 3 rows, equal square cells, generous clear gutters, no labels or grid. Style reference: supplied original atlas; preserve its modern student medical-textbook illustration style, precise teal contour, softly shaded coral, lilac and cyan, crisp easily readable scientific shapes. Revise the construction logic. Row 1: (1) a curved section of lipid bilayer, many TINY coral round heads and paired lilac tails, exactly the same repeating-unit size and thickness as the cell membrane in column 3; (2) a round shallow cutaway aqueous CYAN INTERIOR VOLUME with a gently curved edge, same diameter as the inner space in column 3, NO droplet, NO molecules, NO membrane; (3) a circular membrane bag cutaway, thin coral/lilac bilayer enclosing cyan aqueous interior, no organelles and NO nucleus. Each row1 subject occupies about 80% of its square; lipid section is an arc from the complete membrane, not a single giant molecule. Row2: (1) a lilac tangle of DNA chromatin to occupy a small nucleus, NOT giant double helix; (2) empty lilac nuclear envelope, circular cutaway bowl with tiny pores; (3) same nuclear envelope with the same tangled DNA inside. Each row2 subject is SMALL, occupying only 35% of its square, and same camera orientation. Row3: (1) several parallel pink striated CYLINDRICAL skeletal muscle fibers with small peripheral purple nuclei, NOT spindle-shaped smooth muscle; (2) several small ivory mineral crystals beside a thin bone-matrix chip; (3) fat digestion products: a SEPARATE short pink glycerol backbone and THREE SEPARATE short yellow wavy fatty-acid chains, clearly DISCONNECTED with clear gaps, no bonds between glycerol and fatty acids. Each row3 subject occupies 65% of square. Transparent background throughout; no text, captions, labels, lettering, shadows behind canvas, anatomical scenery or decorative frames. This is a coherent parts family: microscopic scale is constant between membrane fragment, water interior and membrane bag, and between nuclear components.

arm.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit the supplied modern medical textbook arm diagram. Remove ONLY all white and pale cyan page/background to genuine transparency. Keep every bone, tendon, dashed biceps/triceps receiving site, both circular bone matrix enlargements, all labels and all connecting leader lines EXACTLY in their existing position, shape, size, colors and orientation. Preserve the original entire image dimensions and registration. No additions, no redrawing, no composition changes. Anatomy is to become the transparent interactive object on a plain drawing sheet. All empty page space, including below and around the arm and between fingers, must be transparent.
